name: The Twin Wicks
note: Looks like one lamp from a distance, but it is really two stars leaning on each other's light, circling so closely that their glows braid into a single wick.

name: The Breathing Ember
note: A deep red ember whose brightness swells and fades on a slow rhythm, as if the star were drawing breath — some nights it outshines its neighbours, some nights it nearly slips from sight.

name: The Borrowed Lantern
note: A second double: a dim orange star that only reads as bright because a hidden companion lends it light, the two trading places around a point between them.
